2.translation: ## Generic shapes and the plasmid preset ⟦shared:0⟧

3.translation: On the same six source annotations, change only arrow to block. A block omits the directional arrow without changing strand. The third figure shows the combined geom_feature_plasmid preset: width=0.058, arrow_head_length=0.068, arrow_head_width=1.42 and plasmid Position. It changes several defaults and is not a single-parameter contrast. See [shape choices](⟦shared:0⟧) and [arrow/short-feature geometry](⟦shared:1⟧).

10.translation: ## Share placement between overlapping features and labels ⟦shared:0⟧

11.translation: Compare identity versus a shared feature stack on the same six annotations. Pass the Position to both geometry and labels rather than moving text alone. ⟦shared:0⟧ applies an optional base Position before allocating overlap lanes. ⟦shared:1⟧ is a local preset; ⟦shared:2⟧ applies signed offsets by biological strand. Inside/outside is not a substitute for strand evidence.

18.translation: Change only double-line spacing to 0.04, then change the centre length_style size. Keep complete source lengths; do not infer them from maximum feature ends. For FASTA/GenBank/GFF3, check IDs and coordinates in [formats](⟦shared:0⟧). Continue with [circular labels](⟦shared:1⟧), [primers](⟦shared:2⟧), [restriction sites](⟦shared:3⟧) and [tracks](⟦shared:4⟧). Preview at the figure dimensions and use the same width/height in ggsave.
